summary: A revoked client grant is refused on every member whatever order it admitted the pairing and the revocation in, and revalidation checks the canonical newest completion

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change. A store read picks the canonical newest claim through the existing subject and kind index.

compatibility.detail: No wire, stored format or claim kind change. A member that admitted a revocation before the pairing it revokes used to accept the credential; it now refuses it, as other members already did. With two completions of one grant, every member revalidates against the same one.

manual.detail: No manual step. A device whose grant was revoked pairs again to get a new grant, as before.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes; reverting restores the previous reads.
